name: call_aws
description: Execute any AWS CLI command in the payer/management account via cross-account assumed role. Provide the full CLI command string (e.g., 'aws s3api list-buckets', 'aws ec2 describe-instances'). Only read-only operations (describe_*, list_*, get_*) are allowed. Returns the command output as JSON. Optionally pass account_id to query a specific member account instead of the payer (requires finops-mcp-readonly role in that account, deployed via StackSets).

cli_command.description: The full AWS CLI command to execute (e.g., 'aws s3api list-buckets', 'aws ec2 describe-instances --region us-west-2')

account_id.description: Optional 12-digit AWS account ID to target a specific member account. If omitted, defaults to the payer/management account. The target account must have the finops-mcp-readonly IAM role.

name: suggest_aws_commands
description: Get AWS CLI command suggestions based on a natural language query. Useful for discovering the right CLI command to use. Commands will execute in the payer/management account.

query.description: Natural language description of what you want to do (e.g., 'list all S3 buckets', 'get EC2 instance details')
